title: PIANC MarCom WG 211 — Guidelines for the Design, Manufacturing and Testing of Fender Systems 2024 (fender layout and detail figures)
description: Figure titles in the verified BAW-hosted copy cover fender pitch/clearance, chain layouts, tension chains, bracket assemblies, anchors, facing connections and fender panel cross-sections; Tables 2-1 to 2-11 pair typical fender system sketches with performance curves for cone, cell, element/leg, arch/trapezoidal, cylindrical, foam, pneumatic, parallel-motion, pile/pivot and rolling fenders. | Figures: Figure 6.4 — Estimate of maximum fender pitch and minimum clearance to the supporting structure; Figure 8.3 — Typical fender system chain layout (viewed from rear of fender panel); Figure 8.4 — Typical tension chain arrangement; Figure 8.5 — Recommendations for angles and chain arrangement for non-compressed fenders; Figure 8.6 — Double and 4-chain arrangements for foam and pneumatic fenders; Figure 8.7 — Typical examples of fender system bracket assemblies
publisher: PIANC (International Association for Navigation Congresses), MarCom WG 211; copy hosted by Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau (BAW)
licence: Copyright PIANC. BAW-hosted copy consulted for bibliographic/figure-title reference only; do not reproduce figures without PIANC permission. Commercial edition at https://pianc.org/publication/pianc-f
